resources.string: Play your own IPTV playlists (M3U, M3U8, Xtream Codes) with program guides (XMLTV) on your phone, tablet and TV.
This app is a media player only and does not provide any content. No channels are included. You are solely responsible for the legality of the playlists and streams you add.
StreamBox Player does not collect personal data. Your playlists, favorites and settings stay on this device.
